candidates.title: Package Assembly Expansion 1 - World And Entities
candidates.rationale: World and entities are the safest first expansion because current package schema already has maps, entity prototypes and map placements, while Goal 023 exposes region/entity/card gaps that must be resolved before richer quest/economy/combat assembly.
prerequisites: Do not treat region_graph or card gaps as complete support
Define exact world/entity artifact mappings before editing package assembly

candidates.title: Package Assembly Expansion 2 - Dialogue And Quests
candidates.rationale: Quest/dialogue fields and runtime evidence exist, but richer graph and condition contracts depend on clearer world/entity anchors.
prerequisites: Quest graph and dialogue condition gaps scoped

candidates.title: Package Assembly Expansion 3 - Items, Economy And Crafting
candidates.rationale: Economy schema and validators exist, but vendor/crafting profile gaps should follow stable world/entity and quest interaction anchors.
